title: Okviri i usklađenost
summary: NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8.1, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 i SOC 2: čemu služi svaki, kako se razlikuju i kako se tvoj tehnički rad mapira na njih.
summary_en: NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8.1, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and SOC 2: what each is for, how they differ and how your technical work maps to them.
